question.prompt:
A cylinder has 2 bases. If its lateral surface is also counted, what is “the number of bases + 1”?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h106_q2_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: There are 2 bases, and the lateral surface is a single curved surface. As requested, \(2+1=3\).
solutions.title: Adding the supplied counts
